titleEn: The Tang Monk and the River

art.enemyPrompt: A chibi sticker of a full body pale ghost stands on a flat magenta background, with a thick outline and no text. It matches the ghost sprite: a rounded pale blue-white sheet, two dark oval eyes, a small open dark mouth, and two short stubby arms.
art.bossPrompt: A chibi sticker of the little demon stands full body on a flat magenta background, with a thick outline and no text. He is the ghost sprite, a pale blue-white rounded sheet with two dark oval eyes, a small open dark mouth, and two short stubby arms, and he is not dressed as Sun Wukong.
art.backdropPrompt: A wide 16:9 children's storybook landscape of a generic river crossing for The Tang Monk and the River: a bright daytime sky with soft clouds, blue water and pale spray beside grassy banks, floating logs and jagged rocks set off to the sides, and warm earthy ground. A clear empty dirt path runs through the center, open and unoccupied. No characters, no animals, no letters, and no writing.
